sources.snippet: Early detection through regular retinal screening can drastically reduce vision loss — yet, in many regions, access to skilled ophthalmologists remains limited. This project aims to leverage deep learning to assist hospitals and diagnostic centers in detecting Diabetic Retinopathy from retinal fundus images. sources.snippet: Vehicle detector model for aerial images is an F-RCNN trained on VEDAI aerial image dataset. The model can detect and and classify vehicles from aerial images in very challenging conditions and was used to prove the Faster-RCNN's small target detection capability.
